sn46.8:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca upavāno āyasmā ca sāriputto kosambiyaṃ viharanti ghositārāme.
sn46.8:1.2: atha kho āyasmā sāriputto sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā upavāno tenupasaṅkami. upasaṃkamitvā āyasmatā upavānena saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn46.8:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ upavānaṃ etadavoca:
sn46.8:2.1: “jāneyya nu kho āvuso upavāna, bhikkhu paccattaṃ yoniso manasikārā evaṃ susamāraddhā me satta bojjhaṅgā phāsuvihārāya saṃvattantī”ti.
sn46.8:2.2: jāneyya kho āvuso sāriputta bhikkhu paccattaṃ yoniso manasikārā evaṃ susamāraddhā me satta bojjhaṅgā phāsuvihārāya saṃvattantīti.
sn46.8:3.1: satisambojjhaṅgaṃ kho āvuso, bhikkhu ārabbhamāno pajānāti “cittaṃ ca me suvimuttaṃthinamiddhaṃ ca me susamūhataṃ. uddhacca kukkuccañca me suppaṭivinītaṃ. āraddhaṃ ca me viriyaṃ aṭṭhikatvā manasikaromi. no ca līnanti” -pe-
sn46.8:3.2: upekhā sambojjhaṅgaṃ āvuso bhikkhu ārabhamāno pajānāti cittañca me suvimuttaṃ. thīnamiddhañca me susamūhataṃ, uddhaccakukkuccañca me suppaṭivinītaṃ, āraddhā ca me viriyaṃ aṭṭhikatvā manasikaromi no ca līnanti.
sn46.8:3.3: evaṃ kho āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhu jāneyya paccattaṃ yoniso manasikārā susamāraddhā me satta bojjhaṅgā phāsu vihārāya saṃvattantīti.
